create_image_generation: create an image from a text prompt using the image_generation function with a model like dall-e-2
create_image_variation: create a variation of an input image using the image_variation function with a dall-e-2 model
create_image_edit: edit an existing image with a text prompt using the image_edit function with an optional mask
run_async_image_generation: run an async image generation call using aimage_generation with a text prompt and model
run_async_image_edit: run an async image edit call using aimage_edit on an image with a prompt and optional mask
